tools.name: quote-to-policy-issuance
tools.description: Price a coverage quote and immediately bind the policy. Requests a premium quote for a property, then converts the quote into an issued policy in one call.

tools.name: file-claim-for-property
tools.description: Resolve a property's active policy and file a claim against it. The caller only supplies the propertyId and incident details rather than a policyId.

tools.name: coverage-summary-for-property
tools.description: Return a property's active policy plus its full claim history. Combines the policy lookup with its claims list into a single enriched response.
